evidence.detail: The class directly extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and is constructed only by the live custom-interface registry.
Exact surviving text includes 'Enter lottery', 'Lottery title', participant-count text and 'The winning pot is currently..'.
The same screen contains exact section title 'Latest Raffle Winners', fixing the lottery/raffle result history as part of one interface.
Exact presentation includes 'Time until the winner is announced..' and a formatted hours/minutes/seconds countdown.
The builder creates a dedicated entry control with exact text 'Buy-entry'/'Enter lottery' and fountain button/icon resources.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 literal-backed lottery/raffle presentation identity; entry pricing, winner selection and reward authority remain server-owned.
